title: Turtle King on Throne
description: A large anthropomorphic turtle with a green and gold ornate shell sits on a stone throne. It wears an elaborate golden crown and a red royal robe, with one clawed hand resting on a smaller crown placed on a mossy pedestal.
prompt: Anthropomorphic turtle king with a highly detailed green and gold ornate shell, wearing a large golden crown and draped in a rich red royal robe, sitting on an ancient moss-covered stone throne. One clawed hand rests near a smaller golden crown on a pedestal. The background features stone walls with carved turtle motifs, hanging moss, and a dramatic sunset sky with pink and orange clouds. Fantasy style, cinematic lighting, intricate details.
